summary: Verified category rename (inline), drag-and-drop reorder + Save order persistence, duplicate-name 409 alert, delete category with products returning 409, featured product visibility on homepage 'Stories we serve' section, and availability toggle hiding product from public menu. Backend pytest 8/8 pass. Frontend UI drag-drop confirmed working via Playwright drag_and_drop.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: reorder endpoint runs N sequential update_one calls; consider bulk_write for larger category lists (minor).
App.js is minified into a single 26-line file. Extremely hard to maintain/read; recommend splitting into components (Home, Admin, CategoryManager, ProductModal) across separate files.
Frontend uses window.confirm/alert for user feedback which is not test-friendly; consider toast/modal but data-testid coverage is otherwise good.
reorder_categories updates positions serially; if request fails midway there is no transactional rollback (minor for MVP).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (rename, duplicate-reject, drag+save order, featured section, availability toggle)

seed_data_creation: Test featured product created and cleaned up during run. Test category+product pair for 409 delete test cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Playwright's built-in page.drag_and_drop() works with the native HTML5 draggable rows (dispatchEvent DragEvent did NOT trigger React handlers reliably; use drag_and_drop or mouse.down/move/up). Backend reorder endpoint verified: POST /api/admin/categories/reorder {ids:[...]} sets position=index. Login button lacks type='submit' - use text 'Open dashboard' to click.
